change_detection.architecture: Siamese ResNet-based Encoder, Dual Difference Concatenation, U-Net Decoder with Skip Connections
change_detection.dataset: SECOND Semantic Change Detection Benchmark (Yang et al., 2021 IEEE TGRS)

splits.test2: 968 authentic held-out scene pairs (identical physical scenes to test, paired with test2 questions)

change_detection.ground_truth_definition: Canonical change mask: np.any(label1_rgb != label2_rgb, axis=-1)

optical_sar_fusion.architecture: Dual-Stream ResNet Encoders (Optical 3-band + SAR 2-band VV/VH), Multimodal Feature Fusion, Segmentation Head
optical_sar_fusion.ground_truth: ESA WorldCover 10m Land Cover v100 (Authentic Raster GT)
optical_sar_fusion.protocol: parent_granule_disjoint (Strict zero scene/acquisition overlap between train and test)

splits.train: 561 patches (59 unique S2 granules, 137 unique S1 acquisitions)
splits.val_held_out: 120 patches (13 unique S2 granules, 29 unique S1 acquisitions)
splits.test_held_out: 119 patches (14 unique S2 granules, 32 unique S1 acquisitions)

change_vqa.architecture: Salesforce/blip-vqa-base with Bi-temporal Difference Adapter & Constrained Vocabulary Inference
change_vqa.dataset: CDVQA Authentic Benchmark (Yuan et al., 2022 IEEE TGRS)
change_vqa.vocabulary_constraint: Strict 19-token official closed vocabulary across 8 official question types
change_vqa.scoring_method: Length-normalized candidate cross-entropy loss over decoder candidate tokens
change_vqa.evaluated_split: Held-out Test Split (200 balanced samples: 25 per category across all 8 types)

metric_definitions.macro_change_iou: Average of per-pair change IoU: (1/N) * sum(TP_i / (TP_i + FP_i + FN_i))
metric_definitions.micro_change_iou: Dataset-level global change IoU: sum(TP) / (sum(TP) + sum(FP) + sum(FN))
metric_definitions.macro_2class_miou: Average of per-pair 2-class mIoU: (1/N) * sum((IoU_change_i + IoU_nochange_i) / 2)
metric_definitions.pixel_accuracy: Total correct pixels / total evaluated pixels: (sum(TP) + sum(TN)) / Total_Pixels
metric_definitions.optical_sar_macro_miou: Mean IoU across classes: (1/C) * sum(IoU_c) for c in [Built-up, Water, Vegetation]
metric_definitions.vqa_overall_accuracy: Fraction of test questions correctly classified: sum(correct) / total_test_questions
metric_definitions.vqa_average_per_type_accuracy: Macro-average of accuracies across all 8 official question categories: (1/8) * sum(Acc_k)
